title: fix(scenarios): move a card's dates onto the day it runs, so its "today" agrees with the app's real clock

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:场景运行器在每张卡开跑前,把卡里所有日期(`asOf`、种子数据、真值过滤、操作的期望值、提问文字里写的日期)整体平移到运行当天,并按平移后的种子重算真值。
- 为什么改:卡的“今天”固定是 10 月 31 日,但应用按真实时钟记录创建时间;隔了几周再跑,智能体看到矛盾就停下来问,正确的操作因此判失败。
- 风险与回滚:只改 `packages/qa/scenarios` 的运行器(新增一个不对外导出的模块,CLI 调用它),卡片文件不动;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/qa/scenarios/src/runner/run-date.ts` 顶部注释(为什么按整天平移)和 `cli.ts` 循环里的一处调用。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios exec vitest run test/runner/run-date.test.ts`,18 项全过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。请假卡平移后工作日会落到周末,见下文 Acceptance notes,建议另开卡。

## What changes

**Ask 2, rebase the card's dates to the run date.** Ask 1 is not available: the platform has no test-only clock (no clock switch or fake-now in any shipped package), and building one would be a platform capability outside `packages/qa/scenarios`, which the ruling puts out of bounds.

- `src/runner/run-date.ts` (new, not exported from `./runner`): `rebaseScenario(scenario, runDate)` moves every date of a loaded card by one whole-day delta, `runDate − asOf`:
  - `asOf` becomes the run date.
  - Every ISO date (or ISO date-time, time kept) under `run` and `iterate` moves: seed rows, truth filter values, operation `values` and expected post-states.
  - The dates an operation's or question's `ask` writes in its text move too: ISO dates, English `[Weekday] D Month [YYYY]` / `Month D[, YYYY]`, and Chinese `[M 月 ]D 日[(周X)]`. Weekday names are written again for the moved date.
  - The truths are computed again over the moved seed (`truthsOver`). `scopeFigures` stay, because a whole-day shift maps distinct dates to distinct dates.
  - The build prompt and `$comment` are not touched, so a rule like "the leave year starts on 1 July" stays a rule.
- `src/runner/cli.ts`: each card is rebased onto the UTC date it starts on (not once per run, so a long multi-card run does not drift), and the run prints `dates: the card's 2026-10-31 is run as 2026-11-15 …`.
- `README.md`: one bullet on the run date.

**Why whole days, not calendar months.** Ask 3 needs the prompt's "today" to BE the run date, and only a day delta lands there. A day delta keeps every interval exactly: "two weeks out" stays two weeks out, an overdue loaner stays overdue, and a `last_days` window holds the same rows. A `calendar` window is read around the moved today. Its figure is whatever the moved data gives, and the grader holds that same figure, because the truths are recomputed from the moved seed.

## Tests

`test/runner/run-date.test.ts`, 18 tests:

- **Arithmetic:** shift and day counts across a month end, Feb 28 → Mar 1 (2027), Feb 28 → 29 → Mar 1 (2028), and Dec 31 → Jan 1. The `calendar` and `last_days` windows around a moved today keep their month ends and leap days.
- **Every dated card over nine run dates:** 2026-11-15, 11-30, 12-31, 2027-01-01, 02-28, 03-01, 2028-02-28, 02-29, 03-31. For each one:
  - `asOf` equals the run date, and every question and operation prompt says `Today is <run date>.`
  - Every ISO leaf under `run` and `iterate` moved by exactly the delta, and nothing else changed except ask text.
  - Every truth and persona truth equals an independent reading of the UNMOVED seed: each `in_window` filter is replaced by the window around the moved today, moved back by the delta.
  - Every truth without a calendar window equals the card's own figure.
- **Ask text:** the asset and leave asks that write dates name the moved date, and it is the date the operation expects. There are also controls that must not move: a lone `3 日内`, an invalid ISO date, and a number.
- **Ask 3, a run four weeks after `asOf` (2026-11-28):**
  - `extend_overdue_loaner`: the prompt says "move its due date to 2026-12-12. Today is 2026-11-28." The seeded CO-0084 due date is 2026-11-24, still overdue, and the write to 2026-12-12 grades as a pass. The unmoved card grades that same write as a fail; that is the drift this card filed.
  - `dispose_scrapped_asset` and `manager_approves_scrap`: their "today" values are the run date, and a platform-stamped `decided_on` passes.
  - The overdue question's truth is unchanged.
  - The order's example ("`due_on` → run date − 1") was the unmoved reading. Under the shift, the ask's own date moves with the card (`asOf` + 14 days → run date + 14 days).
- **Ablation:** with `run` left unmoved in `rebaseScenario`, 13 of the 18 tests go red. Restored.
- **Ask 4:** the operation grader's `asOf` rule (#31144) tests and the "today" prompt tests (`mid-tier-run-readings.test.ts`) pass unchanged; no existing test was edited. Full suite: 33 files, 800 tests passed. `tsc --noEmit` exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- **A card on working days.** `leave_balances` keeps its seed to Monday–Friday, and its operation asks for leave on "Wednesday 28 October and the morning of Thursday 29". A delta that is not whole weeks moves those days. For example, on 2026-11-15 the ask reads "Sunday 13 December and the morning of Monday 14 December", and the text and values agree. Whether an agent files weekend leave without asking is the card's question, not the runner's. Keeping weekdays would need a whole-week delta, and then "today" would not be the run date, which is the mismatch this card removes. Named as a follow-up in the report.
- A replay (`--driver recorded:F`) re-runs on the replay day, so its card is moved to that day. Its seed and grader agree with each other on that day.
- `docs/qa/scenarios/README.md` (the card authors' guide) still says `asOf` is the fixed "today" the prompts state. That is still true of what an author writes, but the guide could mention the runner's move. It is outside this card's surface, so it is named in the report only.
